title: elaphoglossum squarrosum
intro: Elaphoglossum squarrosum, commonly known as the Rough-leaved Elaphoglossum, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of certain conditions. The therapeutic actions of Elaphoglossum squarrosum include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, suggesting its potential in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
